versions_encoded: as amended by Act 15 of 2019, in force 1 January 2020
scope: Section 301 only. The descriptions of culpable homicide that s 301 transfers are declared as an ontology sourced to ss 299-300; neither of those sections is itself encoded, and neither is s 26G, whose subsection (1) disapplies it where s 301(1) applies.
